metadata.title: बैगा पर मौत का साया | आदिवासी समाचार बुलेटिन | Latest Tribal News of India | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: From Chhattisgarh, case of five deaths in the Baiga community because of diarrhea. Police action against a tribal boy. Long march is being organised for the demand of a separate state in Tripura. Rahul Gandhi's visit to Manipur. BJP's strategy shaken by the defeat on tribal Lok Sabha seats in Jharkhand.
